To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the double-layered coating of silicone/SiNx is an excellent moisture barrier for COB packages with globtop.

the moisture diffusion coefficients of the uncoated, SiNx-coasted, silicone-coated and silicone/SiN double-layered coated COB packages are 1E−5, 0E−5, and 2E−5 mm2/s at 85°C and 85% RH, respectively, and that the double-layered coating has better moisture resistance than the single-layered coatings.

the moisture diffusion coefficients and diffusion activation energy of a double-layered coated globtop sample with silicone and SiNx are 0.2 E-5 mm2 / s and 0.8 eV, respectively, and are the lowest among the three types of coated samples.
In summary, our research is concerned with
moisture diffusion in a COB package with globtop coated with SiNx or silicone, or coated with both of them.
the moisture diffusion of a globtop package with a double-layered organic/inorganic coating.
the moisture diffusion behavior in a COB package with different coatings, and it can be used to design the moisture-resistant COB package.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the double-layered coating has the best moisture resistance, followed by the silicone coating, and the inorganic coating.
the double-layered coating is the best solution for moisture-resistance enhancement.
the moisture diffusion in glob top is affected by coating, and double-layered coating is the best choice to improve the moisture-resistance of the COB packages.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the double-layered SiNx/silicone coating can significantly improve the moisture diffusion properties of the globtop in a COB package.

the diffusion coefficients of moisture in the globtop material are reduced by 50% when the globtop is coated with silicone, and the reduction is 80% when the glob top is double-layered coated with silicone/SiN x.
a double-layered coating of organic/inorganic materials is the best choice to improve moisture-resistance for a chip-on board package.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the double-layered coating is an excellent moisture-resistance solution for COB packages.
the diffusion coefficient is not only a function of the temperature and the humidity but also of the coating material.
a double-layered coating is a good choice for moisture-resistant globtop materials.
